title: This one has been in my head for a solid 20 years
author: FinalLock5596
selftext:
This industrial puzzle game has been in my head for a solid 20 years, since I graduated with my Game Design degree in 2006. 

Tonight I ported it to Steam Deck for giggles (lower left frame). Doesn’t matter if it ever gets a full release, it was just cool to see my idea alive and in my hands, represented by more than just a couple of prototypes.

I love this tech. Few people would get it. I thought y’all might.

comments.author: NephilimXXXX
comments.body: Yeah, I'm confused. He said he ported it to steam deck. Does that mean he made it the game without AI, and then used AI to port it? Not sure.

replies.author: FinalLock5596
replies.body:
Sorry for the confusion! More complicated than all that probably…

I made a platform (Sneklab), where I made the game with AI (Gizmosis), then used an MCP service I created to Sneklab and Claude to port it to Steamdeck.

You can play Gizmosis on Sneklab here (play on a desktop/laptop, not mobile):

https://sneklab.com/prototype/55f9c1c8-81ed-448a-87cc-cac213f3f4e6

I was just geeked on getting it to work on Steamdeck and had to show someone. Electron wrapper wrapping a three.js game loaded directly onto the deck.
